pick.name: electron-builder + electron-updater
pick.what: NSIS/MSIX(AppX)/DMG/AppImage builds + auto-update from GitHub Releases/S3/R2/generic URL
pick.why: Most used Electron packager (5.0M/wk); one config builds Store MSIX and direct-download NSIS; updater works with private/static hosting
pick.install: npm i -D electron-builder && npm i electron-updater

alts.name: Electron Forge + update-electron-app
alts.why: First-party; free update.electronjs.org service for public GitHub repos

candidates.name: electron-builder (pick)
candidates.verdict: Broadest targets incl. appx; best for closed-source updates.

candidates.name: Electron Forge
candidates.verdict: Official and simpler for OSS apps; fewer installer options.

candidates.name: Microsoft Store updates
candidates.verdict: Store handles updates for MSIX installs - use alongside.

decision: electron-builder builds both the Store MSIX and a direct-download NSIS with auto-update from one config. Use Forge if the app is fully open source and you want the official toolchain.
